name: Alias Internet
summary: Small North Perth ISP (PO Box 449, North Perth); dialup, permanent dial-up/ADSL and hosting; WAIA member; defunct by ~2004.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of alias.net.au Aug 2001; WAIA WAIX-class member 2004.
Last real ISP page Feb 2003; alias.net.au a default page by Sep 2004; AS18232 (Alias Internet) later inactive.
